definitions.explanation: a person who wins an election
a person who wins a prize in a drawing, raffle, or lottery

examples.japanese: {当選者|とうせんしゃ}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
{今回|こんかい}の{選挙|せんきょ}では{新人|しんじん}の{当選者|とうせんしゃ}が{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: In this election, there were many first-time winners.

examples.japanese: {当選者|とうせんしゃ}は{選挙管理委員会|せんきょかんりいいんかい}から{正式|せいしき}に{通知|つうち}を{受|う}ける。
examples.english: The elected candidates receive formal notification from the election commission.

examples.japanese: {当選者|とうせんしゃ}には{賞品|しょうひん}をお{届|とど}けします。
examples.english: We will deliver the prize to the winner.

examples.japanese: {抽選|ちゅうせん}の{当選者|とうせんしゃ}は{五名|ごめい}です。
{当選者|とうせんしゃ}の{発表|はっぴょう}は{商品|しょうひん}の{発送|はっそう}をもって{代|か}えさせていただきます。
examples.english: The announcement of the winners will be made by the delivery of the prizes.

notes:
Composed of {当選|とうせん} (winning an election; winning a prize) + {者|しゃ} (person). The word covers both election winners and prize/lottery winners, reflecting the dual meaning of {当選|とうせん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}の{発表|はっぴょう}: announcement of winners
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}に{通知|つうち}する: to notify the winners
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}{一覧|いちらん}: list of winners
- {当選者|とうせんしゃ}{数|すう}: number of winners

USAGE:
The set phrase {当選者|とうせんしゃ}の{発表|はっぴょう}は{商品|しょうひん}の{発送|はっそう}をもって{代|か}えさせていただきます ("the announcement of winners will take the form of prize shipment") is a stock disclaimer found in Japanese prize campaigns, meaning winners will not be publicly announced but will simply receive their prize.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {落選者|らくせんしゃ}: losing candidate — the antonym in election contexts
- {受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}: award recipient — for formal awards and honors, not elections or lotteries
- {入選者|にゅうせんしゃ}: person selected/shortlisted — often used for art contests and literary prizes
